posts.title: Your Agent Doesn't Need Another Summary. It Needs Its History.
posts.description: One thing that bothers me about long-running AI agents is context compaction. When the context window fills up, most agent harnesses ask an LLM to summarize the conversation and continue from there. It works, but summaries lose details, and after a few rounds of summarizing summaries, things can drift quite a bit. The funny thing is that we already have the entire conversation stored on disk. posts.title: The Original Open Source Dream, and What AI Changes
posts.description: There’s an old story about Richard Stallman and a Xerox printer at MIT that I’ve been thinking about recently. The printer kept jamming, and nobody knew until they walked over to collect their printouts. Stallman had previously modified the software of another printer to notify users when there was a paper jam, and wanted to do something similar with the new one.
